notes: Fixes a Selection host announcing the original's build (Selection players were refused from its room). Rooms on another game version or launcher version are refused before joining, with what to do. Watching a running match no longer measures ping. Messages that used to vanish now stay in the status bar: server unreachable or lost, who left, why a match stopped. Server refusals, 2v2 waiting, spectator hints, lag advice and ROM advice are clearer; a replay whose version is missing from the ROM set is explained instead of closing silently; password rooms no longer send their recording.
